Alt+Tab / Alt+Shift+Tab · arrows · Enter: Alt+Tab / Alt+Shift+Tab · arrows se navigate karein · switch karne ke liye Enter · cancel karne ke liye Esc
Auto-hide dock (fullscreen friendly): Dock ko auto-hide karein (fullscreen ke liye useful)
BSP tiling moves visible taskbar windows: BSP tiling har monitor par visible taskbar windows ko arrange karta hai. Ctrl+Alt+J se next tiled window par focus karein, Ctrl+Alt+K se uski position swap karein, Ctrl+Alt+H/L se focused split ka size change karein, Ctrl+Alt+T se layout cycle karein, Ctrl+Alt+F se floating mode toggle karein, aur Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Left/Right se focused window ko previous/next virtual desktop par move karein. Ctrl+Alt+Esc se windows release ho jaati hain. Har workspace ka order aur split sizes save hote hain.
